tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The company shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
All terms and conditions as per uploaded bid documents

The bidder shall quote a lump-sum amount in Indian Rupees for the Inner and Outer Corrugated Boxes (CBs) specified in the Notice Inviting Tender (NIT) for the respective Tender Group Items. After the opening of the financial bids, the L-1 (lowest) bidder shall provide a break-up of the quoted lump-sum amount, indicating the separate rates for the Inner Corrugated Box and the Outer Corrugated Box.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall upload a copy of audited Profit and Loss Accounts duly certified by Chartered Accountant & ITR for the years mentioned above as proof in this regard. Failure to upload the above said documents is liable for rejection.

a. The average annual financial turnover of the tenderer (Non MSEs) should be usually not less than estimated cost of the quantity in the tender document in preceding three financial years (i.e., from 2025-26 and preceding two years OR 2024-25 and preceding two years).Only audited financial turnover are to be uploaded and not provisional turnover. The audited turnover certificate should be certified by Chartered Accountant with their seal and signature.b.For the tender qualified as Micro or Small enterprises (MSEs), The average annual financial turnover of the tenderer should be usually not less than 50 Percent of estimated cost of the quantity in the tender document in last two preceding financial years ending on the relevant financial year. (i.e., 2023-24 and 2024-25). NSIC Certificate to be uploaded compulsorily failing which the bid will be rejected.
